messages:
incident-bot: Pager: MEM_PRESSURE on embeddings-prod-rc1 (host pool: ep-rc1) — p99 memory usage > 92% for 3 consecutive checks. Alert severity: P2.
Aisha: I’m the primary oncall, I’m on it. pulling graphs now.
Leo: copying — do we have customer impact yet? any OOMs or retries?
Samir: I see increased retry rate on embeddings queue ~1.8% -> 3.5%, latency p95 up from 120ms -> 280ms. No explicit OOM kills in kube events yet.
Aisha: thanks. first action: reduce new traffic to that pool, marking ep-rc1 weight=0 in router. Doing now.
Jamie: runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-memory-pressures|embeddings-memory-pressures>. Quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n embeddings -o wide`, `kubectl describe node ep-rc1`, `dmesg | tail -n50` on the host.
Aisha: router change applied, traffic drain started — expect ~30s to take effect. Dropping prefetch to 0 for that pool to prevent additional cache growth.
Samir: I’m watching autoscaler events. Noticed a steady increase in background KV recompute jobs on those instances — could be prefetch + large batch jobs.
Leo: customers: no high-level customer pagers yet, but internal dashboards show small increase in user-facing latency for a few mid-tier customers in us-west. Not global.
Nora: (joining) taking secondary. If prim needs handoff, I can take after tests.
Aisha: thanks @Nora. Current mitigations in progress:
- drain ep-rc1 from load balancer (done)
- scale up a new node in ep-rc2 as warm standby (`pool scale --pool embeddings-prod 1`) — triggered
- kill runaway prefetch workers on ep-rc1: `pkill -f prefetch_worker || true` (doing carefully)
Samir: autoscale kicked, new node provisioning ETA ~3m.
Jamie: note: if node swap doesn’t reduce memory quickly, runbook suggests restarting `embed-service` with `--clear-kv-cache` flag to reclaim KV allocations. That will cause short-lived extra latency; prefer after draining.
Aisha: performed `pkill` on suspected workers on ep-rc1. Memory dropped from 94% -> 78% on host within 40s. No OOMs seen.
Samir: retries trending back down to ~1.6%. p95 latency down to ~150ms. Looks like mitigations effective so far.
Leo: good. Logging: capture heap / pmap output before any service restarts: `gcore` if needed. Jamie: can you add a snapshot to the incident ticket?
Jamie: adding snapshot now and attaching graphs to ticket INC-2048.
Aisha: coverage note: EU night rotation has only one person on-call from 02:00-07:00 UTC tomorrow (Nora). We should document the current state and set a light watch.
Nora: confirmed, I’ll hold watch 0200-0700 UTC. If the pool remains unstable, escalate to platform pager.
Aisha: handoff plan: I’ll stay 15 more minutes to ensure the new node is fully healthy and traffic rebalanced. If stable at T+20m, I’ll hand to Nora. If not, I’ll escalate to oncall lead and open a bridge.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: warm-standby node provisioning for embeddings-prod pool (job-id: prov-7892).
Samir: small action item: check for large batched jobs scheduled in the next hour — there were a couple nightly heavy re-embeds that can spike memory. If present, pause them until pool stabilizes.
Leo: there’s a weekly job at 03:30 UTC (re-embed-runner). Recommend we add a temporary skip flag for embeddings-prod-pool until morning ops check.
Jamie: added a temporary skip to the scheduler for 03:30 run — note in ticket.
Aisha: status update for handoff note: mitigations succeeded, memory normalized, retries reduced, warm standby node joined pool. No customer escalations currently. Remaining actions for next oncall (Nora):
- keep watch on p99 memory for ep-rc1/rc2 for next 3 hours
- verify scheduler skip and re-enable only after approval
- if memory climbs >88% again, runbook step: immediate drain + restart embed-service with `--clear-kv-cache` and notify SRE lead.
Nora: copied. I’ll monitor and post any anomalies to this thread.
Aisha: handing off in 18m unless anything regresses. @Samir please leave your logs/command snippets in the ticket.
Samir: pasted commands and grep snippets into INC-2048 thread.
incident-bot: Note: next oncall transfer scheduled 4314201080 (23:00 UTC) to Nora.
Aisha: thanks team. I’m setting my status to `oncall: handing off` and will DM Nora final checklist shortly. :white_check_mark:
